text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(True! My roots might've been shallow.
Even so—!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(I have never once wanted to lose.
To find a way to win, I must—!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(...Reach, reach, reach, reach, reach!
All the way to victory!!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"REAAAACH THEEEEEMMM!!
DAAAAAAAAAAGHHH!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Royce and Royce!!
Royce and Royce is making her move too!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And the leader crosses the finish line!
No victory for Royce and Royce.
The winner is—"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ――...Did I lose...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Did I... lose...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Why...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I was supposed to win...
for the sake of everything...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more! Just a little more, and!!
I could've won... I could have beaten them all!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Both the glory! And the drama!
We could have had it all!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "How's that!"—I could've said it!! I wanted to say it!! So why the heck did I loooose?!?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
R-Royce...
Pull yourself together...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahideee!
Handkerchief, handkerchief, hurry...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Are you all right?!
I had no idea you were so passionate..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
U-U-Uwaaaaaaaaah!
I wanted to win... I wanted to win so badlyyy.
Whyyyy?!

A sudden collapse of self-restraint.
Followed by a massive explosion of raw emotion!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Royce...!?
Did... did our Royce just break down?

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan A
text_block_list.text: "That Royce-chan, who always gave fan service even after losing..."

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan B
text_block_list.text: "She must've had that much riding on today's race..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~ Royce-chan, wanna go again!?
Nature and I might still wanna run some more.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly, don't go thinking
this settles things between us!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, Tannhauser-san...
Yes, next time, next time for sure,
just you watch...!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And you fans better praise me, adore me,
and pass down my legend next time!!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... Royce-chan somehow bounced back!
Though she feels a bit different than usual...

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, keep it up!!
Give it everything you've got!!!!
(UOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Ha!?

The loudest cheer ever heardâ
enveloped Royce and Royce.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah~~~, I messed up...
I messed up big time...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
How could I make such a huge blunder?!
Exposing such an unsightly, emotional mess... Why on earth did I...?!

If you were to ask "why?"... 
I felt there was only one answer.
choice_data_list: Because those are my true feelings.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh... True feelings? Mine...?

Self-producing to be loved.
Even if I'm not the strongest, I want to be called "the strongest."

"In other words, I couldn't help but think
they all stemmed from the exact same impulse."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: In other words... what it comes down to is...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I want to be acknowledged by everyone.
Commonly referred to as...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: A need for validation~?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my~

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no way~!!!
After working so hard all this time
to become my ideal self, too!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to stand out!
Are you saying that's all I am to youuuu!???

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I thought she was a totally modern Umamusume, but to think she's this stubbornly self-centered...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm disappointed! Aren't we all?!
You, me, the fans—everyone!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
There's no way anyone would still cheer for me...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"There's... no way.
There's no way... right?"

I had a feeling that the actual scenery—
wasn't quite like that.

A massive, fiery explosion of Royce and Royce's emotions.
In response, the fans—

They cheered louder for me than ever before.
That was undeniably—proof of their empathy.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You're saying you'll cheer for me...?
Even someone like me...?

A turmoil within. And to make matters worse,
as if to deal an additional blow to Royce and Royce...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...No way.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hayahide-san and... Ticket-san...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"They said both Hayahide and I need to rest for a while.
Looks like fatigue built up in our legs!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aah, all of BNW have the day off, huh~
Maybe I'll go somewhere with Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I guess I'll never get to race against my sister.
Leaving Royce-kun all by herself weighs on my mind too, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I wish you luck. I'm glad I got to spend
this once-in-a-lifetime season with you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You fools... the both of you.
Because I am...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I was tricking you, okay? I just wanted to make myself look good.
That's the only reason I sidled up to the three of you."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I just wanted to satisfy my desire for approval.
And yet, Hayahide-san and the others still looked out for me even when things were toughest...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... I'm so sorry...
Really... I'm sorry!
Royce and Royce apologized for how she had been acting up until now, but...
choice_data_list: It couldn't have been entirely a lie.
It couldn't have been entirely a lie.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Those tears... are real, aren't they?

text_block_list.text:
The Royce who desperately wants recognition.
The Royce who regrets having deceived others.
Both of them... are the real deal.

Of course, there is ego involved.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Pretentious, selfish,
and yet unable to give up despite being totally ordinary... that's me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: On top of that, even losing her friend from the turf...
choice_data_list: That's a path Nice Nature has walked down too.
That's a path Nice Nature has walked down too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san...
I see. With Teio-san going on break,
you must feel the same way...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to feel this way... if I could help it.
Staying superficial would have been so much easier. But—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I've come to know it.
Myself, and sorrow.
Now, I can—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I can express it even better.
Express 'myself.'"

On Royce and Royce's face,
at long last—
Life has—ignited.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I—want to run.
I want to run again!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I want everyone to acknowledge me through my own self-branding, not some fake image!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
what is the next stage I should aim for?

In that case, the answer is clear. The place where the most eyes in Japanese racing gather.
Namely—

A race that earns recognition from the whole world.
And that race is right around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup...
Tokyo... 2,400 meters...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The same stage as the Japanese Derby,
where I once competed against BNW...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for the wonderful choice.
And also, well—"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Before running in the Japan Cup,
there's someone I just have to talk to!
choice_data_list: Someone I want to talk to? That would be...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Now that I understand what kind of Umamusume I am, once again—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I want to try facing it.
—Facing 'her.'"
